title: Tabular Foundation Models Can Learn Association Rules
abstract: arXiv:2602.14622v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Association Rule Mining (ARM) is a fundamental task for knowledge discovery in tabular data and is widely used in high-stakes decision-making. Classical ARM methods rely on frequent itemset mining, leading to rule explosion and poor scalability, while recent neural approaches mitigate these issues but suffer from degraded performance in low-data regimes. Tabular foundation models (TFMs), pretrained on diverse tabular data with strong in-context generalization, provide a basis for addressing these limitations. We introduce a model-agnostic association rule learning framework that extracts association rules from any conditional probabilistic model over tabular data, enabling us to leverage TFMs. We then introduce TabProbe, an instantiation of our framework that utilizes TFMs as conditional probability estimators to learn association rules out-of-the-box without frequent itemset mining. translated_title: 表格基础模型能够学习关联规则
translated_abstract: 关联规则挖掘（ARM）是从表格数据中进行知识发现的一项基础任务，被广泛应用于高风险决策场景。经典的ARM方法依赖频繁项集挖掘，会导致规则爆炸和可扩展性差的问题；而近期的神经网络方法虽然缓解了这些问题，但在低数据量场景下性能会明显下降。表格基础模型（TFMs）在多样化的表格数据上进行预训练，具有强大的上下文泛化能力，为解决这些局限性提供了基础。我们提出了一个模型无关的关联规则学习框架，能够从任何基于表格数据的条件概率模型中提取关联规则，从而使我们能够利用TFMs。在此基础上，我们介绍了TabProbe，即该框架的一个实例化实现，它将TFMs用作条件概率估计器，无需频繁项集挖掘即可开箱即用地学习关联规则。我们在各种表格数据集上对该方法进行了评估……
tldr: 本文提出了一个模型无关的关联规则学习框架及其实现TabProbe，利用表格基础模型作为条件概率估计器，无需频繁项集挖掘即可从表格数据中学习关联规则，同时克服了经典方法的规则爆炸问题和神经网络方法在低数据量下的性能缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a model-agnostic association rule learning framework and its instantiation TabProbe, which leverages tabular foundation models as conditional probability estimators to learn association rules out-of-the-box without frequent itemset mining, overcoming rule explosion and poor low-data performance of prior approaches.
